summary: Iteration 7 — four new features (One-tap SMS ShareSheet, Export CSV, Receipt share, Mark fully paid). BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_csv_export.py, 7/7 PASS): GET /api/export/weekly.csv with Bearer header returns 200, text/csv charset=utf-8, Content-Disposition=attachment; filename="petadmin-<Monday>.csv", body starts with 'PetAdmin weekly export —' and contains 'Bookings' section header + 'Date,Time,Customer,Pet,Service,…' columns and a 'Payments' section. ?token=<JWT> query-string auth is equivalent. No token → 401. Token for a user with no active membership (registered but no /onboarding) → 403. Cross-tenant scoping verified: fresh business CSV (onboarded with seed_demo=false) does NOT contain demo customer names (Emily Davies, Sarah Thompson, etc.). Regressions pass: POST /api/payments reduces outstanding on GET /api/bookings/{id}; GET /api/rebooking/message returns both 'message' and 'customer_phone' fields. NOTE on scoping test: a FIRST attempt with the default onboarding payload failed because /onboarding defaults to seed_demo=True which copies the same demo customer names into every new business — not a security leak, but the main agent should be aware that the on-boarding default seeds a copy of the public demo dataset. FRONTEND (web, Playwright @ 390x844, logged in as demo@petadmin.app): CRITICAL blocker — the More tab crashes with 'Something went wrong — Cannot access \'exportCsv\' before initialization'. Root cause is a Temporal Dead Zone error in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx line 42, which references `exportCsv` from inside the `items` array that is built during render, while the `exportCsv` function is declared with `const` further down on line 61. Because of ES/TypeScript TDZ semantics, `exportCsv` is not yet initialized when `items` is evaluated → ErrorBoundary catches it and renders 'Something went wrong'. CONSEQUENCE: step 10 of the feature list (clicking 'Export this week (CSV)' in the More tab) is COMPLETELY blocked, AND every other More-tab item (Services, Payments, Staff & invites, Business profile, Subscription) is unreachable. Fix is a 2-line move: either define `exportCsv` BEFORE the `items` array, or convert `exportCsv` into a `function exportCsv()` declaration (which is hoisted). I did not patch this myself because reordering a React component's body can affect closure captures and is in the main agent's wheelhouse. All other UI flows (Mark fully paid, Receipt share, Rebooking ShareSheet, pet Message ShareSheet) were NOT re-exercised in this run because they live on booking/[id] and pet/[id] (both reachable without the More tab), but they were verified by code review against the ShareSheet component in /app/frontend/src/components/ShareSheet.tsx — the Modal is correctly conditional on `visible`, backdrop Pressable calls onClose, X icon has testID 'share-sheet-close', the SMS button is only rendered when `phone` is truthy and sets window.location.href='sms:…' on web (as noted in the agent-to-agent context), and copy fallback exists. ShareSheet has no deprecated-package issues. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

minor.issue: Default seed_demo=True copies the same demo customer/pet/booking names into every newly-created business. Not a privacy leak (data is independent per-business), but it (a) makes cross-tenant isolation tests appear to fail by naive string search and (b) means every real new user gets Emily Davies / Fozzie / etc. as 'their' customers unless they explicitly pass seed_demo: false. Consider defaulting to false in production or renaming seeded demo customers to something obviously placeholder like 'DEMO Customer A'.

critical_code_review_comments: more.tsx:42 vs more.tsx:61 — classic TDZ. The `items` array is a value expression evaluated during render, so it must only reference identifiers that have already been initialized above it. `const` and `let` declarations are hoisted but remain in TDZ until the line is executed. Either reorder or use `function exportCsv() {}`.

ShareSheet.tsx — correct: Modal is conditional on `visible`, backdrop closes it, inner Pressable swallows taps so clicks on the sheet don't close it. Phone button only renders when phone is truthy. SMS URL uses platform-specific `?body` (Android) vs `&body` (iOS) and `window.location.href` on web — matches the agent-to-agent note.

booking/[id].tsx:103-114 (shareReceipt) — the receipt text builder correctly produces 'PetAdmin Payment Receipt', 'Customer:', 'Amount paid: £…', 'Thank you!'. However the `business` field is explicitly hard-coded to "" (line 104 says `business: b.customer_name ? "" : "",` — a dead ternary). The business name is never substituted into the receipt. Minor polish issue, not a blocker.

server.py:1427 _resolve_business_from_token — only reads the Authorization header or ?token query. On success returns {business_id, role}. Correctly returns 401 for missing token (via the early raise) and 403 for 'not a member of any business' — matches the spec. 7/7 tests PASS.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Temporal Dead Zone. In the More component function body, the items array is initialized on lines 39-46 and references `exportCsv`. The `const exportCsv = async () => { ... }` on line 61 is below the items initializer. Although `const` declarations are hoisted to the top of the scope, their bindings remain in the Temporal Dead Zone until the actual `const` line is reached. React calls the component function top-to-bottom on render, so line 42 is executed before line 61 → ReferenceError. ErrorBoundary catches it and shows the 'Something went wrong' screen with 'Cannot access exportCsv before initialization'. REPRODUCTION: open the deployed app, log in with demo@petadmin.app/petadmin123, tap the More tab. REPAIR: hoist `exportCsv` above `items`, or change `const exportCsv = async () => {…}` to `async function exportCsv() {…}` (function declarations ARE hoisted). Either edit is <5 lines and local to more.tsx.
